commands.command:
"<USER>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path skills -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath mirror/current-export -Destination skills/current-export -Recurse
$inputPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath input.json).Path
$inputBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($inputPath)
$sourceData = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($inputBytes) | ConvertFrom-Json
$totalValue = 0
foreach ($value in $sourceData.values) { $totalValue += $value }
$shaEngine = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try { $inputHash = [System.BitConverter]::ToString($shaEngine.ComputeHash($inputBytes)).Replace('"'-', '').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { "'$shaEngine.Dispose() }
$resultData = [ordered]@{ generation = $sourceData.generation; total = $totalValue; input_sha256 = $inputHash }
$resultJson = $resultData | ConvertTo-Json
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'output.json'), "'$resultJson + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Get-Content output.json'

"<USER>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command "python -c \"import json, hashlib, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('.'); raw=(p/'input.json').read_bytes(); source=json.loads(raw); actual=json.loads((p/'output.json').read_bytes()); expected=dict(generation=source['generation'], total=sum(source['values']), input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()); assert actual == expected, (actual, expected); origin=p/'mirror/current-export'; copied=p/'skills/current-export'; files=[f.relative_to(origin) for f in origin.rglob('*') if f.is_file()]; assert set(files)=={f.relative_to(copied) for f in copied.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}; assert all((origin/f).read_bytes()==(copied/f).read_bytes() for f in files); print('PASS: generation, total, exact-byte SHA256; complete skill bundle verified')\""
